meta.name: muapi-storyboard-to-cooking-video
meta.description: Turn a single photo of a person into a 15-second cinematic pasta-making (or other cuisine) tutorial video. First builds a composite reference sheet (character + kitchen + 9-step action board), then animates the full cooking sequence with audio in a single continuous shot.

copy.tagline: 把人物照片变成15秒烹饪教程视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把一张照片快速变成带旁白的烹饪视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a person photo into a 15-second cooking tutorial video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn a single photo into a narrated cooking video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 上传一张人物照片，技能会先生成一张包含角色、厨房和9步动作的参考图，再根据参考图生成一段15秒的烹饪教学视频，保持人物和场景一致。
howto.when: 当你提到“烹饪视频”、“食谱视频”、“美食视频”等关键词，或要求将照片转为烹饪教程时触发。

say.text: 用这张照片做一个意面烹饪视频。
say.note: 技能会生成参考图并制作视频。

say.text: 把这张照片做成寿司卷的教程视频。
用这张照片做一个15秒的披萨制作视频，厨房风格要现代工业风。

howto.what_en: Upload a photo of a person. The skill first generates a composite reference sheet (character + kitchen + 9-step action board), then creates a 15-second cooking tutorial video that keeps the person's face, outfit, and kitchen consistent throughout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "cooking video", "recipe video", "food video", or ask to turn a photo into a cooking tutorial.

say_en.text: Make a pasta cooking video using this photo.
say_en.note: Skill will generate reference sheet and video.

say_en.text: Turn this photo into a sushi roll tutorial video.
say_en.note: You can specify the dish, e.g., sushi rolls.

say_en.text: Make a 15-second pizza video with this photo, kitchen style modern industrial.
